    Unit-normalized representatives of Hochschild two-classes #

    Every Hochschild two-cocycle μ of internal degree q is cohomologous, by the coboundary of the degree-q one-cochain h(a) = a μ(1, 1), to a cocycle vanishing when either argument is 1 (exists_unit_normalized). So statements about the classes of HH²(Λ)_q may be checked on unit-normalized cocycles; this is how the Bockstein statement of Proposition 10.3 (BocksteinStmt) covers every class of HH²(A⁽²⁾)_q.

    IsHCocycle (hcobdry h)

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.GExt.exists_unit_normalized {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {Λ : Type u_2} [Ring Λ] [Algebra R Λ] {GΛ : GAlg Λ} {μ : Λ →ₗ[R] Λ →ₗ[R] Λ} (hμ : IsHCocycle μ) {q : ℤ} (hd : HDeg GΛ μ q) :
    ∃ (h : Λ →ₗ[R] Λ), (∀ (p : ℤ) (a : Λ), GΛ.gr.IsHom p a → GΛ.gr.IsHom (p + q) (h a)) ∧ IsHCocycle (μ - hcobdry h) ∧ (∀ (a : Λ), ((μ - hcobdry h) 1) a = 0) ∧ ∀ (a : Λ), ((μ - hcobdry h) a) 1 = 0

    Every Hochschild two-cocycle of internal degree q is cohomologous to a unit-normalized one: subtract the coboundary of h(a) = a μ(1, 1), of degree q.
